questions.question: Who was appointed as the new Chief Minister of Haryana in March 2024 after the resignation of Manohar Lal Khattar?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nayab Singh Saini**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Nayab Singh Saini has been elected as the new Chief Minister of Haryana, succeeding Manohar Lal Khattar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• This development follows the resignation of the senior** BJP leader Manohar Lal Khattar** and his entire cabinet amidst the visible cracks in the **BJP-JJP alliance.**
 
• **Nayab Saini **is the** BJP Lok Sabha MP** from **Kurukshetra **and has been a significant figure among the **Other Backward Classes (OBC).** 
 
• He was appointed as the party's state head in **October 2023.**
 
• In the **90-member Haryana Assembly**, the BJP holds 41 seats and has the support of 5 independent MLAs and the Haryana Lokhit Party MLA, Gopal Kanda.
 
• The resignation of Khattar came after the BJP's alliance with the Jannayak Janata Party (JJP) led by **Deputy CM Dushyant Chautala, **which had 10 MLAs, broke down mainly over seat sharing for Lok Sabha polls.

questions.question: Who is the current Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh (As of March 2024)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu serves as MLA representing the Nadaun constituency of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• He is a fourth-term legislator from Nadaun and was chosen by the party's high command to lead the government in the hill-state
 
• His deputy Mukesh Agnihotri is from the Una district and has been re-elected from the Haroli assembly segment for the fifth consecutive term.
 
• Agnihotri was first elected to the state assembly in 2003 and remained chief parliamentary secretary in the Virbhadra Singh-led government.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Himachal Pradesh:

 
 
• Governor: Shiv Pratap Shukla
 
• Chief Minister: Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu

questions.question: Who is the new Chief Minister of Odisha? (As of June 2024)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is ​__**Mohan Charan Majhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Mohan Charan Majhi has become the new Odisha Chief Minister. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• This decision was made following a meeting of the newly-elected BJP MLAs in Odisha, where Majhi was elected as the leader of the BJP legislature party.
 
• **The announcement of Majhi’s election as Chief Minister was made by Rajnath Singh,** the Defence Minister of India, who was present as one of the central observers during the MLA meeting.
 
• This marks a significant political development as it will be the first BJP government in Odisha, showcasing a shift in political dynamics within the state.
 
• The BJP secured a majority in the recent assembly elections by winning 78 of the 147 seats available, paving the way for Mohan Charan Majhi's leadership.
 
• **The chief of the Biju Janata Dal Naveen Patnaik concluded his 24-year tenure as the CM** of the state following a significant defeat in the State elections. 
 
• **The BJP won 78 of 147 seats in the Odisha assembly. **
 
• Odisha capital: Bhubaneswar.

questions.question: Who administered the oath of office to Omar Abdullah as the Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir?(October 2024)

questions.question: The previous Governor of Bihar, Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar, has been appointed as the Governor of which state? (As of December 2024)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar, the former Governor of Bihar, has been appointed as the Governor of Kerala.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar served as the Governor of Bihar prior to his new appointment.
 
• He has now been appointed as the Governor of Kerala, succeeding Arif Mohammed Khan.
 
• **Arif Mohammed Khan has been appointed as the new Governor of Bihar.**
 
• These changes were part of recent gubernatorial appointments by President Droupadi Murmu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar:**__

 __
 
• Served as the Governor of Bihar prior to his new role in Kerala.
 
• Known for his dedication to constitutional values and administrative leadership.
 
 
 
• **Other Recent Appointments:**__
 
 
• Arif Mohammed Khan was appointed as the Governor of Bihar, replacing Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar.
 
• Ajay Kumar Bhalla was appointed as the Governor of Manipur, succeeding Lakshman Prasad Acharya.
 
• Hari Babu Kambhampati, the former Governor of Mizoram, has been appointed as the Governor of Odisha.
 
• Vijay Kumar Singh, Retd. General, will replace Hari Babu Kambhampati as the Governor of Mizoram.

questions.question: Who has been sworn in as the 25th Governor of Mizoram? (Jan 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **V K Singh**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Gen (Retd) VK Singh**, former Army Chief, was sworn in as the **25th Governor of Mizoram** on Thursday, succeeding Hari Babu Kambhampati, now appointed as Odisha Governor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **oath of office and secrecy** was administered by Gauhati High Court Chief Justice **Vijay Bishnoi** at Raj Bhawan, Aizawl.
 
• The ceremony was attended by dignitaries, including Mizoram Chief Minister **Lalduhoma**, former CMs **Zoramthanga** and **Lal Thanhawla**, and Assembly Speaker **Lalbiakzama**.
 
• Singh served as the **24th Chief of the Army Staff (COAS)** from 2010 to 2012 and was the first Indian Army Chief to take legal action against the Centre over a **dispute on his date of birth**.
 
• Post-retirement, he joined the **BJP in 2014**, became a Member of Parliament from **Ghaziabad**, and held ministerial roles, including **Minister of State for Road Transport and Highways** and **Minister of State for External Affairs**.
 
• Mizoram shares **722 kilometers of international borders** with Bangladesh (west) and Myanmar (east and south) and has inter-state borders with Assam, Manipur, and Tripura.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Governor of Manipur by President Droupadi Murmu on December 24, 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajay Kumar Bhalla**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **President Droupadi Murmu** appointed new governors for **five states**, announced by the President's Secretariat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Ajay Kumar Bhalla**, a retired **1984-batch IAS officer**, and former **Union Home Secretary (2019-2024)**, was appointed as the **Governor of Manipur**.
 
• **Arif Mohammed Khan**, former **Kerala Governor (2019)**, was reassigned as the **Governor of Bihar**. He is known for his **stance on Shah Bano case** and his **Lok Sabha tenure**.
 
• **Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar**, previously the **Governor of Bihar**, was appointed as the **Governor of Kerala**, following earlier roles with **RSS and BJP**.
 
• **General Vijay Kumar Singh (Retd.)**, former **Army Chief and Union Minister**, became the **Governor of Mizoram**, recognized for his role in the **1971 Bangladesh Liberation War** and **Sri Lanka peacekeeping operations**.
 
• **Hari Babu Kambhampati**, the outgoing **Mizoram Governor**, replaced **Raghubar Das** as the **Governor of Odisha** after the latter's **resignation**.
 
• All appointments are effective upon the appointees assuming charge of their respective offices.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the 45th Governor of Rajasthan in July 2024?
questions.solution:
Correct Answer: A) Haribhau Kisanrao Bagde

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Haribhau Kisanrao Bagde was sworn in as the Governor of Rajasthan on July 31, 2024.**
 
• He replaced Kalraj Mishra, whose tenure ended on July 21, 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The oath was administered by Rajasthan High Court Chief Justice Manindra Mohan Shrivastava.
 
• Mr. Bagde, aged 78, took the oath in Hindi at Raj Bhavan, Jaipur.
 
• He is a former Maharashtra Assembly Speaker and a veteran RSS leader.
 
• Mr. Bagde emphasized development, cooperative movement in tribal areas, and timely implementation of centrally-sponsored schemes.
